description: draft-ietf-jmap-mdn-17 §2: 'forEmailId MUST NOT be null for MDN/send'. When the client supplies forEmailId: null (or omits it), the handler (crate-jmap-mail-server/src/mdn.rs step 4-6) lets the entry fall through to the backend. The MemoryBackend (tests/common/mod.rs:2286-2296) returns SetErrorType::NotFound with description 'forEmailId is required', but the correct JMAP error for a MUST NOT be null violation is invalidProperties (RFC 8620 §5.3), not notFound. A real backend or a future refactor may not even check this. Fix: handle_mdn_send should validate that every Mdn in the send map has a non-null for_email_id before calling the backend, returning invalidProperties per-entry for any that are null.
title: MDN/send: null forEmailId wrong error type
